description: Thin labeled-section wrapper that renders TmNotionPageCommentPanel, forwarding the page id, expanded state, and the expanded, count, and mention callbacks.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: Page identifier whose page-level comment threads are displayed.

parameters.name: Expanded
parameters.description: Whether the page comment section is expanded.

parameters.name: OnCountChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the comment count may have changed.

parameters.name: OnExpandedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the expanded state changes.

parameters.name: OnMentionClicked
parameters.description: Raised when a user mention inside a comment is activated.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Pass-through of the embedded panel's OnDraftChanged: forwards the panel's deduped TmNotionCommentDraftState transitions so a host rendering the section gets the same draft-guard visibility as the bare panel. Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard after the host's own confirmation.
